product_summary: Hytech Didactic (Hytech Group, Pune, Maharashtra; est. 1992) is a manufacturer of TVET/educational training equipment and industrial-automation training cells. Real product lines from the company website (hytechdidactic.com, Home + About Us pages): (1) Hydraulics & Pneumatics training kits — Electrohydraulic Training Kit, Hydraulic Excavator System, Electropneumatic Training Kit, Colour Based Sorting Conveyor; (2) PLC & HMI training kits — Briefcase, Basic and Advance PLC-HMI kits; (3) Robotics cells — SCARA Training Cell, Handling Robocell with PLC-HMI-IIOT, COBOT Training Cell, MIG Welding Robocell, SPOT Welding Robocell, Integrated Robotic Assembly Cell with dual robots, Deburring/Polishing/Engraving Cell, AMR with automation station and COBOT; (4) Smart Factory with 7-axis robot and Digital Twin; (5) Computer Integrated Manufacturing System with Digital Twin; (6) Mechatronics & Industrial Automation stations — Automated Bottle Filling Station, Automated Press Assembly Station, Automated Bolt Assembly Station, Vision Inspection Station (Smart Vision), VFD & Plotter Training Kit, Sensor Training Kits (generic with IO-Link, Pokayoke), Servo Motor Training Kit; (7) CNC Training — CNC Simulators (Fanuc/Siemens), CNC Maintenance Training Kit (turning & milling). Also software/AR-VR/digital-twin content (Siemens Mechatronics Concept Designer, Technomatix, Unity/Vuforia).
comment: HS 847989 ('machines and mechanical appliances having individual functions, nes') is only partially right. It is defensible for the mechanical training cells/stations (bottle filling, press assembly, bolt assembly, sorting conveyor, excavator system) but it is NOT the correct primary heading for the bulk of the catalogue. The dominant, most specific heading is 9023 00 — 'instruments, apparatus and models designed for demonstrational purposes, unsuitable for other uses, used for teaching' — which is exactly what TVET training kits/simulators are; the company itself describes its output as 'educational training related equipment' for the TVET ecosystem. Robotics cells with an integrated industrial robot (SCARA, COBOT, 6-axis, welding robocells) fall under 8479 50 (industrial robots, nes); welding robocells may additionally attract 8515 if welding heads are supplied as the functional element. PLC/HMI training kits and control panels map to 8537 10 (boards/panels equipped with two or more apparatus of 8535/8536, for electric control) or 8543 70 for the electronic training units; CNC simulators/maintenance kits to 8458/8459 (lathes for metal removal) or 9023 00 when demonstrational; sensor/servo/VFD kits to 8543 70 / 8501 (servo motors) / 8504 (VFD). Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the website shows no process, refinery, pipeline, wellhead or chemical-plant equipment at all — the actual industry is educational/TVET lab equipment and industrial automation/robotics. Trader signs: none found — the About page states an own manufacturing setup in Pune (~18,000 sq ft) plus a regional sales office in Sharjah, UAE, and claims 16,000+ installations in India and 200+ outside India; that is a manufacturer profile, though the Sharjah office and 'Hytech Group' structure mean some supplies may be routed/assembled rather than made in-house. Product lines missing from the declaration: the entire 9023 demonstrational/teaching-apparatus line, industrial robots (8479 50), CNC machines (8458/8459), electric control panels (8537 10) and the software/digital-twin/AR-VR component (likely 8523/9973 services, not goods). Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, declared code corrected to the actual list above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data is from the company's own website (hytechdidactic.com) — no customs line was available to me in this task, so the specific shipment-level HS codes are 'заявлено, не подтверждено'; the product existence itself is corroborated by the published catalogue, the HS mapping is my classification, not a customs record.
